integrity: Analytic argument with reproducible numerical consistency checker; no independent external audit or certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Valid for embedded constant-radius tubes over C4 simple closed planar cores. The all-surfaces Willmore profile need not equal the restricted tube profile. The forward curvature energy identity is previously known. The global remainder coefficient is not claimed best; the Fourier spectral bound is local. Historical priority of a special-case optimization cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp isoperimetric Willmore envelope and curvature-mode rigidity for planar-core tubes
